mapper.select: SELECT CASE_KIND_CD AS "caseKindCd", SUM(CASE WHEN FR_DT IS NOT NULL AND FR_DT BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "occurrenceCnt", SUM(CASE WHEN DCSN_DT BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND RSLT_KIND_CD IN #{w} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "winCnt", SUM(CASE WHEN DCSN_DT BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND RSLT_KIND_CD IN #{l} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "loseCnt", SUM(CASE WHEN RSLT_KIND_CD = #{processingCd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "processingCnt" FROM LAW_SUIT WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND CASE_KIND_CD IN (#{minsaCd}, #{hangjungCd}, #{kukgaCd}, #{simpanCd}) GROUP BY CASE_KIND_CD

SELECT INSTANCE_CD AS "instanceCd", SUM(CASE WHEN CASE_KIND_CD = #{minsaCd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "minsaCnt", SUM(CASE WHEN CASE_KIND_CD = #{hangjungCd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hangjungCnt", SUM(CASE WHEN CASE_KIND_CD = #{kukgaCd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "kukgaCnt", SUM(CASE WHEN CASE_KIND_CD = #{simpanCd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "simpanCnt" FROM LAW_SUIT WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND RSLT_KIND_CD = #{processingCd} AND INSTANCE_CD IN (#{inst1}, #{inst2}, #{inst3}) AND FR_DT >= #{fromDate} AND FR_DT <= #{toDate} GROUP BY INSTANCE_CD

SELECT c.CODE AS "civilCaseCd", c.CODE_NM AS "name", COUNT(su.SUIT_ID) AS "totCnt", SUM(CASE WHEN su.CASE_KIND_CD = #{minsaCd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "minsaCnt", SUM(CASE WHEN su.CASE_KIND_CD = #{hangjungCd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hangjungCnt", SUM(CASE WHEN su.CASE_KIND_CD = #{kukgaCd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "kukgaCnt", SUM(CASE WHEN su.CASE_KIND_CD = #{simpanCd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "simpanCnt" FROM COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE c LEFT JOIN LAW_SUIT su ON su.CIVIL_CASE_CD = c.CODE AND su.DEL_YN = 'N' AND su.RSLT_KIND_CD = #{processingCd} AND su.FR_DT >= #{fromDate} AND su.FR_DT <= #{toDate} WHERE c.CODE_ID = 'LAW_CIVIL_CASE' AND c.USE_AT = 'Y' GROUP BY c.CODE, c.CODE_NM, c.CODE_DC ORDER BY c.CODE_DC, c.CODE

SELECT og.ORGNZT_ID AS "orgnztId", og.ORGNZT_NM AS "name", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t.caseKindCd = #{minsaCd} AND t.hasLawyer = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "minsaLawer", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t.caseKindCd = #{minsaCd} AND t.hasLawyer = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "minsaGong", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t.caseKindCd = #{hangjungCd} AND t.hasLawyer = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "hangjungLawer", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t.caseKindCd = #{hangjungCd} AND t.hasLawyer = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "hangjungGong", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t.caseKindCd = #{kukgaCd} AND t.hasLawyer = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "kukgaLawer", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t.caseKindCd = #{kukgaCd} AND t.hasLawyer = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "kukgaGong", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t.caseKindCd = #{simpanCd} AND t.hasLawyer = 'L' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "simpanLawer", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t.caseKindCd = #{simpanCd} AND t.hasLawyer = 'G' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "simpanGong" FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO og LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT s.ORGNZT_ID AS orgnztId, su.SUIT_ID AS suitId, su.CASE_KIND_CD AS caseKindCd, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LAW_SUIT_LAWYER l WHERE l.SUIT_ID = su.SUIT_ID) THEN 'L' ELSE 'G' END AS hasLawyer FROM LAW_SUIT_STAFF s JOIN LAW_SUIT su ON s.SUIT_ID = su.SUIT_ID WHERE su.DEL_YN = 'N' AND su.RSLT_KIND_CD = #{processingCd} AND s.ORGNZT_ID IS NOT NULL AND su.FR_DT >= #{fromDate} AND su.FR_DT <= #{toDate} ) t ON t.orgnztId = og.ORGNZT_ID GROUP BY og.ORGNZT_ID, og.ORGNZT_NM ORDER BY og.ORGNZT_NM

SELECT lw.LAW_FIRM AS "companyName", lw.LAWYER_NM AS "name", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN su.RSLT_KIND_CD = #{processingCd} THEN su.SUIT_ID END) AS "processingCnt", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN su.RSLT_KIND_CD IS NOT NULL AND su.RSLT_KIND_CD != #{processingCd} THEN su.SUIT_ID END) AS "terminatedCnt", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN su.RSLT_KIND_CD IN #{w} THEN su.SUIT_ID END) AS "winCnt", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN su.RSLT_KIND_CD IN #{l} THEN su.SUIT_ID END) AS "loseCnt", NVL(SUM(NVL(su.SUIT_AMT,0) + NVL(su.WIN_AMT,0) + NVL(su.LOSE_AMT,0)), 0) AS "totAmt" FROM LAW_SUIT_LAWYER a JOIN LAW_LAWYER lw ON a.LAWYER_ID = lw.LAWYER_ID JOIN LAW_SUIT su ON a.SUIT_ID = su.SUIT_ID WHERE su.DEL_YN = 'N' AND su.FR_DT >= #{fromDate} AND su.FR_DT <= #{toDate} GROUP BY lw.LAW_FIRM, lw.LAWYER_NM ORDER BY lw.LAW_FIRM, lw.LAWYER_NM

SELECT og.ORGNZT_NM AS "companyName", s.STAFF_NM AS "name", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN su.RSLT_KIND_CD = #{processingCd} THEN su.SUIT_ID END) AS "processingCnt", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN su.RSLT_KIND_CD IS NOT NULL AND su.RSLT_KIND_CD != #{processingCd} THEN su.SUIT_ID END) AS "terminatedCnt", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN su.RSLT_KIND_CD IN #{w} THEN su.SUIT_ID END) AS "winCnt", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN su.RSLT_KIND_CD IN #{l} THEN su.SUIT_ID END) AS "loseCnt", NVL(SUM(NVL(su.SUIT_AMT,0) + NVL(su.WIN_AMT,0) + NVL(su.LOSE_AMT,0)), 0) AS "totAmt" FROM LAW_SUIT_STAFF s JOIN LAW_SUIT su ON s.SUIT_ID = su.SUIT_ID LEFT JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO og ON s.ORGNZT_ID = og.ORGNZT_ID WHERE su.DEL_YN = 'N' AND su.FR_DT >= #{fromDate} AND su.FR_DT <= #{toDate} GROUP BY og.ORGNZT_NM, s.STAFF_NM ORDER BY og.ORGNZT_NM, s.STAFF_NM

SELECT c.CODE AS "code", c.CODE_NM AS "codeName", COUNT(su.SUIT_ID) AS "cnt" FROM COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE c LEFT JOIN LAW_SUIT su ON su.LOSS_CAUSE_CD = c.CODE AND su.DEL_YN = 'N' AND su.DCSN_DT BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} WHERE c.CODE_ID = 'LAW_LOSS_CAUSE' AND c.USE_AT = 'Y' GROUP BY c.CODE, c.CODE_NM, c.CODE_DC ORDER BY c.CODE_DC, c.CODE
